payload.core_mechanism_summary: Two-pass tree DP counting triples based on lucky edges: bottom-up computes dp_up (size of subtrees reachable via lucky paths), top-down computes dp_down to combine and sum over all nodes.
payload.rationale: The solution performs DP on a tree with two traversals (post-order and pre-order) to compute per-node values that contribute to the final count. This is a classic tree DP pattern.
